description: Qwen3.5 9B vision-language model via Ollama (also the 'latest' tag): laptop-size local model for simple edits and chat.
notes: NOT INSTALLED: pull with `ollama pull qwen3.5:9b`. Download 6.6GB (8.95B dense, Q4_K_M default tag), needs ~9GB RAM plus KV cache; fits the 48GB M4 Max. Library context 256K; limit set to 131072 because Ollama sizes context from VRAM (assumes OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH raised). No independent benchmark found; slightly below gemma4:26b (5.0) for coding, better at reasoning with thinking on. Q4 quantization already accounted for. Latency estimated for M4 Max 48GB by scaling measured gemma4:26b (78 tok/s, ~4B active) by active-weight bytes; not measured. Thinking is on by default: pass think=false for fast answers. Default 'latest' tag is this 9b. Page checked 2026-10-25.
